messages:
Zoe Kim: quick QA note — on dashboard the compact primary button at 360px looks cramped; icon touches badge. Screenshot attached.
Ben Hart: I noticed that too. We rolled spacing.tight into a few components last sprint; might be too aggressive for icon+label combos.
Priya Patel: small proposal: keep spacing.tight for layouts but add component tokens: --button-compact-gap: 10px and --button-compact-pad-x: 12px. Keep vertical padding 6px to keep 44px touch.
Jin Soo: dev +1 for component vars. I'll implement CSS vars with fallbacks so old apps don't break. Will add migration note.
Zoe Kim: another layering issue: toasts occasionally render above modals on Integrations. Toast z-index is higher than modal header.
Ben Hart: layering is messy — we have numeric z-values scattered. Suggest semantic tokens: layer.toast, layer.modal, layer.fab, then map to numbers per app at runtime.
Priya Patel: copy: product wants toast CTAs short — "Undo" / "View". And tooltips must show user-friendly copy, not token names like spacing.tight.
Jin Soo: quick CSS prototype I'll push:
```css
:root { --btn-compact-gap: 10px; --btn-pad-y: 6px; --layer-toast: 1200; --layer-modal: 1100; }
.button--compact { padding: var(--btn-pad-y) 12px; gap: var(--btn-compact-gap); min-width:44px; min-height:44px; }
.toast { z-index: var(--layer-toast); right: 16px; bottom: 16px; }
.modal { z-index: var(--layer-modal); }
@media (max-width:420px){ .toast-stack{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; } }
```
I'll open a PR with visual diffs.
a11y-bot: checklist: icon-only buttons must have aria-label, focus-visible present, minimum 44px hit target, toasts use aria-live="polite" (info) or role="alert" (errors), and actionable toasts must be keyboard reachable.
Zoe Kim: please add an a11y checklist to the component PR template and include light/dark screenshots for visual diffs.
Ben Hart: will add checklist + migration blurb. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/519 (pushing now).
Priya Patel: thanks — quick mobile note: stack toasts under 420px vertically and don't let newest toast cover primary FAB. Prefer newest at bottom so it doesn't hide CTAs.
Jin Soo: noted — I'll reverse stack order on mobile and ensure focus order is predictable. Will ping when PR is ready for review.
